evidence.description: REQ-A1 kill_server: tmux kill-server with 5s timeout; rc/timeout/OSError branches produce specified statuses. Verified against test_A1_kill_server_invokes_tmux/_rc_fail/_timeout.
REQ-A2 escalate_via_bot2bot: anicca_home empty → deferred; missing script → escalate-no-script-continue; rc/timeout branches present. Matches spec §Group-A REQ-A2 and EDGE-E5.

REQ-B1 send_keys: FIND-001 fix confirmed — both params.keys (direct) and params.flow (mapped via SEND_KEYS_FLOW_MAP with reinject_startup→/startup) are handled; unknown flow returns send_keys-unknown-flow-<F> without invoking tmux; missing both returns send_keys-noop-no-params; params.enter appends Enter.

REQ-C2 npm_install: FIND-2-001 fix confirmed — status echoes 'npm_install-ok-flow=allowlist_check' at line 184 when flow=allowlist_check; missing flow → plain 'npm_install-ok'; unknown flow → 'npm_install-ok-flow=<F>'. Aligns with test_C2_npm_install_flow_consumed/_missing/_unknown.
Dispatcher passes anicca_home=os.environ.get('ANICCA_HOME','/Users/operator/anicca') to execute_recipe, satisfying spec §Group-C signature-change contract.
REQ-I4: SCAFFOLD_DEFERRED_ACTIONS = frozenset({'noop'}) — matches spec 'emptied or reduced to noop' and verified by test_scaffold_deferred_actions_constant_is_noop_only.
EDGE-E1 timeout coverage: kill_server, escalate, send_keys, login, npm_install, git_checkout all have explicit TimeoutExpired tests asserting fail-soft ok:False statuses.

EDGE-E3 missing-params + EDGE-E5/E6 missing-script + empty anicca_home: covered by escalate_missing_script, login_missing_script, send_keys_unknown_flow, send_keys_noop_no_params, git_checkout_missing_target_defaults, group_C_empty_anicca_home_fail_soft.
EDGE-E2 subprocess FileNotFoundError/OSError branches implemented for all 6 wires returning '<action>-failed-<ErrorName>'.
INV-P1 preserved: restart branch only runs for issue_kind=='tmux_dead'; stale+restart → 'stale-suppressed-INV-P1' short-circuits before cmd_map lookup.
Legacy PROP-I1 static-grep regression guard: dispatcher forbidden pattern check ensures no accidental tmux kill-* leaked into orchestrator.
Defense-in-depth: kill-server references confined to action=='kill_server' branch; --stop/--kill/kill-session still forbidden.
send_keys uses '--' delimiter to protect key payload; str(keys) coerces non-string mapped values safely.
SEND_KEYS_FLOW_MAP and NPM_INSTALL_FLOW_MAP declared as module-level dicts near top; open/closed for extension without touching wire logic.
execute_recipe signature is keyword-only, backward-compatible: anicca_home defaults to '' so existing callers (test_step3_recipe.py restart tests) continue to work without change.
Each of the 6 wires is a self-contained if-branch with its own subprocess.run + try/except; no cross-branch state, easy to grep/verify.
PROP-I2 AST guard: every subprocess.run node in step3_recipe.py verified to be inside a Try ancestor; assertion protects future edits from leaking uncaught exceptions.
PROP-I3 INV-4 grep guard: step3_recipe.py contains no 'loops/', '.jsonl', or '.sentinel' string literals — the 6 wires cannot write slot state.
PROP-I1 branch-scoped grep confirms none of the 6 new action branches reference cmd_map, isolating restart-map coupling to the restart+tmux_dead branch only.
Signature guard: execute_recipe kwargs asserted to include anicca_home — Group-C contract change enforced by test.
Purity boundary honored: execute_recipe is the sole I/O shell; status string construction is pure and side-effect-free per verification-architecture.md.
